notes: The box shifts every character up by one ASCII code and inserts a literal `'Y'` after `round(len/2)` characters (banker's rounding). I derived the insertion position from all six E1 examples (lengths 6,5,11,25,11,5 → positions 3,2,6,12,6,2), and confirmed the shift is plain ASCII+1 (not Caesar wrap) since `z→{`, `Z→[`, space→`!`.
